:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s131}

## [13.1]{.section-number}From Moment Restrictions to Probability Models

::: {.topic-opening}
Chapter 12의 GMM은 data distribution이 만족해야 하는 일부 moment restrictions를 사용했다.
Likelihood-based estimation은 한 단계 더 나아가 관측자료의 parametric probability family 자체를 명시한다.
:::

### 13.1.1 Moment models versus likelihood models {#s1311}

moment-based model은

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[g(W,\theta_0)]=0
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

와 같은 제한만 요구한다. 반면 parametric likelihood model은

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
W\sim P_\theta,
\qquad
\theta\in\Theta,
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

또는 density가 존재하면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
W\sim f_\theta(w)
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

와 같이 distribution family 전체를 명시한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-grid}

::::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card}

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__title}

Moment model

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__formula}

$$
E[g(W,\theta_0)]=0
$$

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__text}

distribution의 특정 restrictions만 사용한다.

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card}

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__title}

Likelihood model

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__formula}

$$
W\sim f_\theta
$$

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::: {.comparison-card__text}

parametric family 안에서 전체 distributional shape를 사용한다.

::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.1.2 More structure, more information, more assumptions {#s1312}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.callout-strip}

::::::::::::::::::: {.left}

Likelihood trade-off

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.right}

Correctly specified parametric likelihood는 distributional structure를 더 많이 사용하므로 높은 efficiency를 제공할 수 있다.
그러나 동시에 moment-based methods보다 더 많은 specification assumptions에 의존한다.
따라서 “더 많은 정보”와 “더 많은 modeling risk”는 함께 움직인다.

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{more structure}
\Longrightarrow
\text{potentially more efficiency}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\text{more specification exposure}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

연결 13.1 · Likelihood models imply moment restrictions, but not conversely

:::::::::::::::::::

regular parametric likelihood model은 다음 score moment를 생성한다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
s(W,\theta)
=
\nabla_\theta\log f_\theta(W),
\qquad
E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 likelihood model은 특정한 moment restriction들의 집합을 함의한다. 반면 finite set of restrictions는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[g(W,\theta_0)]=0
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

일반적으로 $W$의 전체 probability law를 결정하지 못한다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{likelihood model}
\Rightarrow
\text{moment restrictions},
\qquad
\text{moment restrictions}
\not\Rightarrow
\text{unique likelihood model}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s132}

## [13.2]{.section-number}Likelihood, Log-Likelihood, and Conditional Likelihood

::: {.topic-opening}
Likelihood는 관측된 sample을 고정한 뒤 각 parameter value가 그 sample에 부여하는 relative fit을 나타내는 function이다.
:::

### 13.2.1 Likelihood and log-likelihood {#s1321}

i.i.d. observations $W_1,\ldots,W_n$의 density가 $f_\theta(w)$라 하자.
sample likelihood는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
L_n(\theta)
=
\prod_{i=1}^n f_\theta(W_i).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

logarithm은 product를 sum으로 바꾼다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\ell_n(\theta)
=
\log L_n(\theta)
=
\sum_{i=1}^n\log f_\theta(W_i).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

log는 strictly increasing이므로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta L_n(\theta)
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta \ell_n(\theta).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

Maximum likelihood estimator는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\theta_{MLE}
\in
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta\in\Theta}
\ell_n(\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.1 · Maximizing likelihood and log-likelihood are equivalent

:::::::::::::::::::

Whenever $L_n(\theta)\gt0$,

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta\in\Theta}
L_n(\theta)
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta\in\Theta}
\log L_n(\theta).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

logarithm은 $(0,\infty)$에서 strictly increasing이다. 따라서 임의의 $\theta_1,\theta_2$에 대해

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
L_n(\theta_1)\ge L_n(\theta_2)
\iff
\log L_n(\theta_1)\ge\log L_n(\theta_2).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

parameter value들의 순서는 변하지 않으므로 argmax set도 일치한다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.2.2 Likelihood is not a density for the parameter {#s1322}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

주의 13.1 · Likelihood와 posterior는 다르다

:::::::::::::::::::

관측된 data $w$를 고정하면 $L(\theta;w)$는 $\theta$의 function이지만,
frequentist likelihood에서는 $\theta$의 probability density가 아니다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
L(\theta;w)
\neq
p(\theta\mid w).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.2.3 Conditional likelihood {#s1323}

Econometrics에서는 $X$의 marginal law 전체를 parameterize하지 않고 conditional law만 model하는 경우가 많다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_\theta(y,x)
=
f_\theta(y\mid x)f_X(x).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

$f_X$가 $\theta$와 무관하다면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\theta
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
\sum_{i=1}^n
\log f_\theta(Y_i\mid X_i).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

를 사용하면 된다. Logit, probit, Poisson regression 등의 기본 likelihood가 이 conditional form이다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

예제 13.1 · A likelihood is not a probability density over the parameter

:::::::::::::::::::

$Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$이 success probability $p$를 갖는 Bernoulli라고 하자. sample을 관측한 뒤에는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
L(p)
=
p^{\sum_iY_i}
(1-p)^{n-\sum_iY_i},
\qquad
0\le p\le1.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이는 $p$의 함수이지만, frequentist likelihood는 를 요구하지 않는다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\int_0^1L(p)\,dp=1.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

posterior density를 만들려면 추가적인 prior와 normalization이 필요하다. 따라서

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
L(p;y)
\neq
p(p\mid y)
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

as mathematical objects.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.2 · Conditional and joint likelihoods have the same $	heta$-argmax when $f_X$ is ancillary for $	heta$

:::::::::::::::::::

If

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_\theta(y,x)
=
f_\theta(y\mid x)f_X(x),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이고 $f_X$가 $\theta$에 의존하지 않으면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
\sum_i\log f_\theta(Y_i,X_i)
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
\sum_i\log f_\theta(Y_i\mid X_i).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

joint log likelihood는 다음과 같이 분해된다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_n^{joint}(\theta)
=
\sum_i\log f_\theta(Y_i\mid X_i)
+
\sum_i\log f_X(X_i).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

두 번째 항은 $\theta$에 대해 상수이므로 이를 더해도 argmax는 변하지 않는다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s133}

## [13.3]{.section-number}Population Likelihood, KL Divergence, and Identification

::: {.topic-opening}
Sample likelihood를 논하기 전에 population에서 likelihood가 어떤 target을 정의하는지부터 분명히 해야 한다.
:::

### 13.3.1 Population expected log likelihood {#s1331}

true data law의 density를 $f_0$라 하자. Population expected log likelihood는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
M(\theta)
=
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

따라서 likelihood-defined population target은

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^\dagger
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta\in\Theta}
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.3.2 KL projection {#s1332}

Kullback–Leibler divergence를

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)
=
E_0
\left[
\log
\frac{f_0(W)}{f_\theta(W)}
\right]
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라 하자. 그러면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)
=
E_0[\log f_0(W)]
-
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)].
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

첫 번째 항은 $\theta$에 무관하므로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)]
=
\operatorname*{arg\,min}_\theta
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

즉 likelihood target은 true distribution을 parametric family에 KL sense로 projection한 parameter다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.1A · Gibbs inequality and nonnegativity of KL divergence

:::::::::::::::::::

relevant support에서 $f_0$가 $f_\theta$에 대해 absolutely continuous이고 logarithm이 integrable하다고 하자. 그러면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)
=
E_0\left[
\log\frac{f_0(W)}{f_\theta(W)}
\right]
\ge0.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

usual equality condition 아래에서 equality는 $f_\theta=f_0$가 $P_0$-almost surely일 때만 성립한다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

$x=f_\theta(W)/f_0(W)$로 두고 $\log x\le x-1$을 사용하자. 그러면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\begin{aligned}
-D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)
&=
E_0\left[
\log\frac{f_\theta(W)}{f_0(W)}
\right]\\
&\le
E_0\left[
\frac{f_\theta(W)}{f_0(W)}-1
\right]\\
&=
\int f_\theta(w)\,dw-1\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 $D_{KL}\ge0$이다. Equality가 성립하려면 $\log x\le x-1$의 equality condition이 성립해야 하므로 $f_\theta/f_0=1$ almost surely이다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.1B · Correct specification + distributional identification implies a unique population likelihood maximizer

:::::::::::::::::::

Assume

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_0=f_{\theta_0}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

and

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_\theta=f_{\theta_0}\ P_0\text{-a.s.}
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
\theta=\theta_0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Then

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta_0
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta\in\Theta}
E_{\theta_0}[\log f_\theta(W)].
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

For any $\theta$,

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\begin{aligned}
M(\theta_0)-M(\theta)
&=
E_{\theta_0}
\left[
\log\frac{f_{\theta_0}(W)}{f_\theta(W)}
\right]\\
&=
D_{KL}(f_{\theta_0}\Vert f_\theta)\\
&\ge0.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 $\theta_0$가 population criterion을 최대화한다. Equality는 $f_\theta=f_{\theta_0}$ almost surely를 의미하고, identification condition으로부터 $\theta=\theta_0$를 얻는다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.3.3 Correct specification and misspecification {#s1333}

<strong>Correct specification:</strong>

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_0=f_{\theta_0}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이고 parameterization이 identified라면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^\dagger=\theta_0.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

<strong>Misspecification:</strong>

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_0
\notin
\{f_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^\dagger
=
\text{KL-best approximation within the working family}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

Remark · “Pseudo-true”는 criterion-relative한 개념이다

:::::::::::::::::::

$\theta^\dagger$는 likelihood criterion이 정의한 population target이다.
이것이 structural or causal truth인지 여부는 별도의 model interpretation과 identification assumptions에 달려 있다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .identification}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

식별 13.1 · Observational equivalence set in likelihood models

:::::::::::::::::::

model이 correctly specified이지만 point identified가 아니라면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\Theta_0
=
\{
\theta\in\Theta:
P_\theta=P_0
\}.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

로 정의하자. 모든 $\theta\in\Theta_0$는 동일한 population expected log likelihood를 달성한다. 따라서 likelihood maximization만으로는 unique parameter vector가 아니라 $\Theta_0$만 identify할 수 있다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{likelihood maximization}
\neq
\text{automatic point identification}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

주의 13.1A · Support matters for KL geometry

:::::::::::::::::::

$P_0(A)\gt0$인 어떤 집합 $A$가 존재하여 $A$ 위에서 $f_\theta(w)=0$이고 $f_0(w)\gt0$라면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)=+\infty.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 common-support 또는 absolute-continuity condition은 단순한 기술적 장식이 아니라 population likelihood geometry의 일부다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s134}

## [13.4]{.section-number}MLE as an M-Estimator and the Score as a Z-Equation

::: {.topic-opening}
Maximum likelihood는 Chapter 11의 general M/Z framework 안에 정확히 들어간다.
:::

### 13.4.1 MLE as M-estimation {#s1341}

negative log likelihood를 loss로 두자.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\rho(W,\theta)
=
-\log f_\theta(W).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

그러면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\theta_{MLE}
=
\operatorname*{arg\,min}_\theta
P_n\rho(W,\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{Maximum likelihood is an M-estimator.}
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.4.2 Score equations {#s1342}

개별 score를

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
s(W,\theta)
=
\nabla_\theta\log f_\theta(W)
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

로 정의한다. Sample score:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
S_n(\theta)
=
\nabla_\theta\ell_n(\theta)
=
\sum_{i=1}^n s(W_i,\theta).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

interior smooth optimum에서는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
S_n(\widehat\theta)=0.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

따라서 regular smooth MLE는 score-based Z-estimator로도 볼 수 있다.

### 13.4.3 FOC is not the definition of MLE {#s1343}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

주의 13.2 · Score zero는 candidate condition

:::::::::::::::::::

$S_n(\theta)=0$은 stationary point를 나타낼 뿐 global maximum을 보장하지 않는다.
Boundary solution, parameter-dependent support, nonconcavity, multiple stationary points에서는 score equation만으로 MLE를 정의할 수 없다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
S_n(\theta)=0
\not\Rightarrow
\theta\text{ is the MLE}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.1 · Score zero does not characterize the global MLE

:::::::::::::::::::

다음과 같은 smooth한 log-likelihood 형태의 objective를 생각하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell(\theta)
=
-(\theta^2-1)^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Its score is

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell'(\theta)
=
-4\theta(\theta^2-1),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

그러면 stationary points는 $-1,0,1$이다. 그러나

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell(-1)=\ell(1)=0,
\qquad
\ell(0)=-1.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 $\theta=0$은 score equation을 만족하지만 maximizer는 아니다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s135}

## [13.5]{.section-number}Consistency of Maximum Likelihood

::: {.topic-opening}
MLE consistency는 Chapter 11의 M-estimator consistency theorem을 expected log-likelihood에 적용한 결과다.
:::

### 13.5.1 Uniform convergence and separation {#s1351}

normalized log likelihood를

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M_n(\theta)
=
\frac1n\ell_n(\theta)
=
P_n\log f_\theta
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라 하고 population criterion을

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M(\theta)
=
P_0\log f_\theta
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라 하자. 핵심 conditions는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sup_{\theta\in\Theta}
|M_n(\theta)-M(\theta)|
\overset p\longrightarrow0
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

와, 모든 $\varepsilon\gt0$에 대해

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
M(\theta^\dagger)
>
\sup_{\|\theta-\theta^\dagger\|\ge\varepsilon}
M(\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라는 separated maximum이다.

### 13.5.2 What MLE is consistent for {#s1352}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.1 · Basic likelihood consistency

:::::::::::::::::::

uniform convergence와 separated population maximum이 성립하고 $\widehat\theta$가 exact 또는 asymptotically exact maximizer이면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\theta
\overset p\longrightarrow
\theta^\dagger.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명 · Likelihood argmax consistency

:::::::::::::::::::

$\varepsilon\gt0$를 고정하고 population separation gap을

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\Delta_\varepsilon
=
M(\theta^\dagger)
-
\sup_{\|\theta-\theta^\dagger\|\ge\varepsilon}
M(\theta)
\gt0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Also let

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\delta_n
=
\sup_{\theta\in\Theta}
|M_n(\theta)-M(\theta)|
=
o_p(1),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

로 정의하자. 또한 estimator가 다음 near-maximizer condition을 만족한다고 하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M_n(\widehat\theta_n)
\ge
\sup_{\theta\in\Theta}M_n(\theta)-r_n,
\qquad
r_n=o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$\delta_n\lt\Delta_\varepsilon/3$이고 $r_n\lt\Delta_\varepsilon/3$인 사건 위에서 $\|\theta-\theta^\dagger\|\ge\varepsilon$인 parameter는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M_n(\theta)
\le
M(\theta^\dagger)-2\Delta_\varepsilon/3,
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

while

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M_n(\theta^\dagger)
\ge
M(\theta^\dagger)-\Delta_\varepsilon/3.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 만족한다. 따라서 이러한 $\theta$는 near-maximizer가 될 수 없다. 그러므로

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
P(\|\widehat\theta_n-\theta^\dagger\|\ge\varepsilon)
\to0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

correct specification이면 $\theta^\dagger=\theta_0$, misspecification이면 $\theta^\dagger$는 KL pseudo-true target이다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.callout-strip}

::::::::::::::::::: {.left}

중요

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.right}

MLE consistency theorem은 model truth를 만들어주지 않는다.
이 theorem이 말하는 것은 sample likelihood maximizer가 population expected log-likelihood maximizer를 학습한다는 것이다.

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

해석 13.1 · Consistency estimates the population criterion target, not model truth

:::::::::::::::::::

The conclusion

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widehat\theta_n\overset p\longrightarrow\theta^\dagger
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

는 $E_0[\log f_\theta]$의 maximizer를 학습한다는 진술이다. 이것이 를 의미하지는 않는다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_0=f_{\theta^\dagger}.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

correct specification은 estimator consistency의 결과가 아니라 별도의 assumption이다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s136}

## [13.6]{.section-number}Score, Hessian, and Fisher Information

::: {.topic-opening}
Correctly specified regular likelihood의 특별한 구조는 score variance와 expected curvature가 일치한다는 데 있다.
:::

### 13.6.1 Score mean-zero identity {#s1361}

regular density에서

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\int f_\theta(w)\,dw=1.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

differentiation under the integral sign이 허용되면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
0
=
\int
\frac{\partial f_\theta(w)}
{\partial\theta}
dw.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

$\partial_\theta f_\theta=f_\theta s_\theta$이므로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.3 · Score mean-zero identity

:::::::::::::::::::

support가 parameter-independent이고 differentiation을 integral 안으로 통과시킬 수 있다고 하자. 그러면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

Because

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\int f_\theta(w)\,dw=1,
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

differentiating gives

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
0
=
\int
\frac{\partial f_\theta(w)}{\partial\theta}
\,dw.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Using

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial f_\theta(w)}{\partial\theta}
=
f_\theta(w)
\nabla_\theta\log f_\theta(w)
=
f_\theta(w)s(W,\theta),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

we obtain $E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0$.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.6.2 Hessian and score variance {#s1362}

개별 log-likelihood Hessian:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
H(W,\theta)
=
\nabla_\theta^2\log f_\theta(W).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

Expected negative Hessian:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal H(\theta)
=
-
E_\theta[H(W,\theta)].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

Score outer-product matrix:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal J(\theta)
=
E_\theta[
s(W,\theta)s(W,\theta)'
].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.6.3 Information matrix equality {#s1363}

regular correctly specified likelihood에서는 second differentiation identity로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal H(\theta)
=
\mathcal J(\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이 공통 matrix를 Fisher information이라 한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal I(\theta)
=
E_\theta[s_\theta s_\theta']
=
-
E_\theta[\nabla_\theta^2\log f_\theta(W)].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.2A · Information matrix equality

:::::::::::::::::::

regular correct specification, common support, 그리고 integral 아래 differentiation이 valid하다는 조건 아래에서

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
-
E_\theta[
\nabla_\theta^2\log f_\theta(W)
]
=
E_\theta[
s(W,\theta)s(W,\theta)'
].
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

score identity
$$
E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0
$$
를 미분하자. Componentwise로는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
0
=
\int
\left[
\frac{\partial s(W,\theta)}{\partial\theta'}
f_\theta(W)
+
s(W,\theta)
\frac{\partial f_\theta(W)}{\partial\theta'}
\right]dW.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Since

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial f_\theta(W)}{\partial\theta'}
=
f_\theta(W)s(W,\theta)',
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

it follows that

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E_\theta\left[
\frac{\partial s(W,\theta)}{\partial\theta'}
\right]
+
E_\theta[s(W,\theta)s(W,\theta)']
=
0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$\partial s/\partial\theta'=\nabla_\theta^2\log f_\theta$이므로 항을 정리하면 결과를 얻는다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.6.4 Observed and expected information {#s1364}

<strong>Observed information:</strong>

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal I_n^{obs}(\theta)
=
-\nabla_\theta^2\ell_n(\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

<strong>Expected information:</strong>

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal I_n^{exp}(\theta)
=
n\mathcal I(\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

finite sample에서는 서로 다를 수 있지만 regular correctly specified settings에서 normalized versions는 같은 population information matrix를 추정한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.2 · Parameter-dependent support breaks the regular score identity

:::::::::::::::::::

Let

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
Y\sim U(0,\theta),
\qquad
f_\theta(y)=\frac1\theta\mathbf1\{0\le y\le\theta\}.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

interior sample point $0\lt y\lt\theta$에서 formal score는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
s(y,\theta)
=
-\frac1\theta.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E_\theta[s(Y,\theta)]
=
-\frac1\theta
\neq0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

모순은 없다. support가 $\theta$에 의존하므로 $\int_0^\theta \theta^{-1}dy=1$을 미분할 때 boundary term이 필요하다. 따라서 regular interchange argument를 적용할 수 없다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{parameter-dependent support}
\Rightarrow
\text{regular score identities may fail}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리표 13.1 · Three information objects

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.display-table-wrap}

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Object</th><th>Definition</th><th>Population role</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Observed information</td><td>$-\nabla^2\ell_n(\theta)$</td><td>sample curvature</td></tr>
<tr><td>OPG</td><td>$\sum_i s_i(\theta)s_i(\theta)'$</td><td>sample score covariance</td></tr>
<tr><td>Expected information</td><td>$n\mathcal I(\theta)$</td><td>correct specification 아래 expected curvature / score variance</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

:::::::::::::::::::

regular correct specification 아래에서는 normalized observed information과 expected information이 동일한 $\mathcal I(\theta_0)$로 수렴한다. Misspecification 아래에서는 Hessian과 OPG가 일반적으로 서로 다른 matrix로 수렴한다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s137}

## [13.7]{.section-number}Asymptotic Normality and Efficiency of MLE

::: {.topic-opening}
MLE asymptotic normality는 score의 CLT와 Hessian의 LLN을 결합한 Chapter 11 smooth M-estimation argument의 특수사례다.
:::

### 13.7.1 Score expansion {#s1371}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

엄밀화 13.1 · Exact multivariate score expansion via an integrated Hessian

:::::::::::::::::::

Define

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\bar H_n
=
\int_0^1
\frac1n
\nabla_\theta S_n
\left(
\theta_0+t(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
\right)
dt.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

그러면 fundamental theorem of calculus에 의해 다음 exact vector identity를 얻는다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac1nS_n(\widehat\theta)
-
\frac1nS_n(\theta_0)
=
\bar H_n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

interior exact MLE에서는 $S_n(\widehat\theta)=0$이므로

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
=
-\bar H_n^{-1}
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

Let

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
g(t)
=
\frac1n
S_n\left(
\theta_0+t(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
\right).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Then

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
g'(t)
=
\frac1n
\nabla_\theta S_n
\left(
\theta_0+t(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
\right)
(\widehat\theta-\theta_0).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$0$에서 $1$까지 적분하면 exact expansion을 얻는다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.7.2 Inverse-information variance {#s1372}

correct specification과 regularity 아래

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0)
\overset d\longrightarrow
N(0,\mathcal I(\theta_0)),
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

그리고

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
-\frac1n\nabla_\theta S_n(\widetilde\theta)
\overset p\longrightarrow
\mathcal I(\theta_0).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.2 · Regular MLE asymptotic normality

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
\overset d\longrightarrow
N\!\left(
0,
\mathcal I(\theta_0)^{-1}
\right).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명 · Regular MLE asymptotic normality

:::::::::::::::::::

integrated-Hessian identity에 의해

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
=
-\bar H_n^{-1}
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

correct specification과 score CLT 아래에서

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0)
\Rightarrow
N(0,\mathcal I_0),
\qquad
\mathcal I_0=\mathcal I(\theta_0).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

consistency와 local Hessian LLN에 의해

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
-\bar H_n\overset p\longrightarrow\mathcal I_0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence $-\bar H_n^{-1}\to_p\mathcal I_0^{-1}$. Slutsky gives

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
\Rightarrow
N(0,\mathcal I_0^{-1}).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

regular parametric models에서 이 inverse-information covariance는 MLE의 asymptotic efficiency와 연결된다.

### 13.7.3 Why the sandwich collapses {#s1373}

Chapter 11의 generic smooth M-estimator variance는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
H^{-1}BH^{-1}.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

correct likelihood에서는 information matrix equality에 의해

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
B=H=\mathcal I.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

따라서

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
H^{-1}BH^{-1}
=
\mathcal I^{-1}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.callout-strip}

::::::::::::::::::: {.left}

Likelihood의 특별함

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.right}

$I^{-1}$은 generic M-estimation과 별개의 variance formula가 아니다.
Correctly specified regular likelihood에서 일반 sandwich가 information identity 때문에 단순화된 결과다.

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.2B · MLE asymptotic linear representation

:::::::::::::::::::

regular MLE conditions 아래에서는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\theta-\theta_0
=
\frac1n
\sum_{i=1}^n
\mathcal I_0^{-1}
s(W_i,\theta_0)
+
o_p(n^{-1/2}).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 first-order influence contribution은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
IF(W)
=
\mathcal I_0^{-1}s(W,\theta_0).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

asymptotic score expansion으로부터

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
=
\mathcal I_0^{-1}
\frac1{\sqrt n}\sum_i s(W_i,\theta_0)
+
o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$\sqrt n$으로 나누면 다음 representation을 얻는다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.2C · Parametric efficiency in the regular asymptotically linear class

:::::::::::::::::::

regular asymptotically linear estimator의 influence function $\phi(W)$가 다음을 만족한다고 하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[\phi(W)s(W,\theta_0)']
=
I_K.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Then

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E[\phi\phi']
-
\mathcal I_0^{-1}
\succeq0.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

MLE influence function $\phi^*=\mathcal I_0^{-1}s$는 lower bound를 달성한다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명 · Parametric information bound within the stated class

:::::::::::::::::::

Write

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\phi
=
\phi^*
+
r,
\qquad
\phi^*=\mathcal I_0^{-1}s.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

normalization condition은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[rs']
=
E[\phi s']
-
\mathcal I_0^{-1}E[ss']
=
I_K-I_K
=
0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 의미한다. 따라서 $r$과 $\phi^*$ 사이의 cross covariance는 0이다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[r\phi^{*'}]
=
E[rs']\mathcal I_0^{-1}
=
0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[\phi\phi']
=
E[\phi^*\phi^{*'}]
+
E[rr']
=
\mathcal I_0^{-1}
+
E[rr'].
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$E[rr']\succeq0$이므로 결과가 따른다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s138}

## [13.8]{.section-number}Quasi-Maximum Likelihood and Misspecification

::: {.topic-opening}
Working likelihood가 true data density를 포함하지 않아도 likelihood criterion 자체는 여전히 population target과 estimator를 정의한다.
이때 estimator를 quasi-MLE로 해석한다.
:::

### 13.8.1 Working likelihood and pseudo-true target {#s1381}

true density가 parametric family 바깥에 있다고 하자.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_0
\notin
\{f_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

그래도 sample estimator는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widehat\theta_{QMLE}
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
\sum_i\log f_\theta(W_i)
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

로 정의할 수 있다. Population target은

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^\dagger
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_\theta
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)]
=
\operatorname*{arg\,min}_\theta
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.8.2 Pseudo-score condition {#s1382}

$\theta^\dagger$가 interior이고 differentiation이 허용되면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E_0[s(W,\theta^\dagger)]=0.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

즉 quasi-likelihood는 pseudo-true target에서 score moment equation을 생성한다.

### 13.8.3 Information equality can fail {#s1383}

misspecification 아래에는 기대값이 true law $P_0$에 의해 계산되므로 일반적으로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E_0[s s']
\neq
-
E_0[H].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

Correct likelihood에서 특별했던 information matrix equality가 더 이상 보장되지 않는다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

예제 13.2 · Gaussian working likelihood under nonnormal data

:::::::::::::::::::

true scalar $Y$가 finite mean과 variance를 가지지만 반드시 normal일 필요는 없다고 하자. Gaussian working family를 사용하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
Y\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

상수항을 제외하면 population expected log likelihood는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M(\mu,\sigma^2)
=
-\frac12\log\sigma^2
-
\frac{1}{2\sigma^2}
E[(Y-\mu)^2].
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

고정된 $\sigma^2$에서 $M$을 최대화하는 것은 $E[(Y-\mu)^2]$를 최소화하는 것과 같으므로

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\mu^\dagger=E[Y].
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이 값을 대입하고 $\sigma^2$에 대해 최대화하면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sigma^{2\dagger}
=
\operatorname{Var}(Y).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 incorrect Gaussian density를 사용하더라도 meaningful한 pseudo-true mean과 variance parameter를 얻을 수 있다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.3 · A boundary pseudo-true maximizer need not satisfy the pseudo-score equation

:::::::::::::::::::

Let

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\Theta=[0,\infty),
\qquad
M(\theta)=-(\theta+1)^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

population maximizer는 boundary point $\theta^\dagger=0$이지만

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
M'(0)=-2\neq0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이다. 따라서 $E_0[s(W,\theta^\dagger)]=0$은 interior differentiable optimum을 필요로 하며 pseudo-true maximizer에 대한 universal property가 아니다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s139}

## [13.9]{.section-number}Robust Sandwich Covariance for QMLE

::: {.topic-opening}
Information equality가 깨지면 inverse Hessian alone으로는 sampling variability를 정확히 표현할 수 없다.
General M-estimator sandwich가 다시 등장한다.
:::

### 13.9.1 Bread and meat {#s1391}

pseudo-true target에서

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
H
=
-
E_0[
\nabla_\theta^2
\log f_{\theta^\dagger}(W)
]
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

와

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
J
=
E_0[
s(W,\theta^\dagger)
s(W,\theta^\dagger)'
]
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

를 정의한다. 그러면 regular QMLE asymptotics는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .theorem}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

정리 13.3 · QMLE sandwich asymptotics

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta^\dagger)
\overset d\longrightarrow
N(0,H^{-1}JH^{-1}).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명 · QMLE sandwich asymptotics

:::::::::::::::::::

interior pseudo-true target에서 sample score는 integrated-Hessian expansion을 만족한다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
0
=
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta^\dagger)
+
\bar H_n
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta^\dagger),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

where

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
-\bar H_n\overset p\longrightarrow H.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Therefore

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta^\dagger)
=
H^{-1}
\frac1{\sqrt n}
S_n(\theta^\dagger)
+
o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

score CLT 아래에서

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta^\dagger)
\Rightarrow
N(0,J).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta^\dagger)
\Rightarrow
N(0,H^{-1}JH^{-1}).
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.9.2 Correct versus misspecified likelihood {#s1392}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.display-table-wrap}

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Case</th><th>Curvature / score variance</th><th>Asymptotic variance</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Correct regular likelihood</td>
<td>$H=J=\mathcal I$</td>
<td>$\mathcal I^{-1}$</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Misspecified / quasi likelihood</td>
<td>$H\neq J$ generally</td>
<td>$H^{-1}JH^{-1}$</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.9.3 Sample covariance estimator {#s1393}

sample analogues:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widehat H
=
-\frac1n
\sum_{i=1}^n
\nabla_\theta^2
\log f_{\widehat\theta}(W_i),
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widehat J
=
\frac1n
\sum_{i=1}^n
s(W_i,\widehat\theta)
s(W_i,\widehat\theta)'.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

따라서 robust covariance는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat V
=
\widehat H^{-1}
\widehat J
\widehat H^{-1}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

$\widehat V$는 $\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta^\dagger)$의 covariance estimator이며,
estimator 자체의 covariance는 asymptotically $n^{-1}\widehat V$다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

주의 13.3 · Robust standard errors do not repair the target

:::::::::::::::::::

sandwich covariance는 misspecified likelihood에서 pseudo-true target 주변의 sampling uncertainty를 robust하게 추정한다.
이는 working likelihood를 true model로 만들거나 $\theta^\dagger$를 structural/causal target으로 바꾸는 것이 아니다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.4 · Plug-in sandwich consistency

:::::::::::::::::::

Hessian과 score outer product에 대해 local ULLN이 성립하고 $\widehat\theta\to_p\theta^\dagger$라고 하자. 그러면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widehat H\overset p\longrightarrow H,
\qquad
\widehat J\overset p\longrightarrow J,
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

and therefore

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat H^{-1}
\widehat J
\widehat H^{-1}
\overset p\longrightarrow
H^{-1}JH^{-1}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

Chapter 11의 random-index plug-in logic을

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_H(W,\theta)
=
-\nabla_\theta^2\log f_\theta(W),
\qquad
f_J(W,\theta)
=
s(W,\theta)s(W,\theta)'.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

에 적용할 수 있다. Local ULLN과 $\widehat\theta\to_p\theta^\dagger$로부터 두 matrix의 probability limit를 얻는다. $H$가 nonsingular이므로 inverse continuity와 Slutsky에 의해 sandwich limit가 따른다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.4 · Inverse Hessian alone can be wrong under misspecification

:::::::::::::::::::

다음 working model을 사용하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
Y\sim N(\mu,1)
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

한편 true distribution은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[Y]=\mu_0,
\qquad
\operatorname{Var}(Y)=\tau^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 만족한다고 하자. Score는 $s(Y,\mu)=Y-\mu$이므로 $\mu^\dagger=\mu_0$이다. pseudo-true target에서

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
H=1,
\qquad
J=\tau^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Therefore

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
V_{QMLE}
=
H^{-1}JH^{-1}
=
\tau^2.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

naive inverse-Hessian variance는 $1$이며, 이는 $\tau^2=1$일 때만 올바르다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s1310}

## [13.10]{.section-number}Wald, Likelihood-Ratio, and Score Tests

::: {.topic-opening}
Regular correctly specified likelihood에서는 동일한 local quadratic geometry에서 Wald, likelihood-ratio, score tests가 나온다.
:::

### 13.10.1 Restricted and unrestricted estimation {#s13101}

$q$-dimensional restriction

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
H_0:
r(\theta)=0
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

를 생각하자. Unrestricted MLE를 $\widehat\theta$, restricted MLE를

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widetilde\theta
=
\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\theta:r(\theta)=0}
\ell_n(\theta)
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라 하자.

### 13.10.2 Wald test {#s13102}

Wald test는 unrestricted estimate가 null manifold에서 얼마나 떨어져 있는지를 covariance metric으로 측정한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
W
=
n\,
r(\widehat\theta)'
\left[
R(\widehat\theta)
\widehat V
R(\widehat\theta)'
\right]^{-1}
r(\widehat\theta),
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

where $R(\theta)=\partial r(\theta)/\partial\theta'$.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
W\overset d\longrightarrow\chi_q^2
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

regular null asymptotics 아래에서는

### 13.10.3 Likelihood-ratio test {#s13103}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
LR
=
2[
\ell_n(\widehat\theta)
-
\ell_n(\widetilde\theta)
].
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

regular correctly specified model에서

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
LR\overset d\longrightarrow\chi_q^2.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.10.4 Score / LM test {#s13104}

Score test는 restricted estimator에서 likelihood slope가 얼마나 zero에서 벗어나는지를 측정한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
LM
\approx
S_n(\widetilde\theta)'
\mathcal I_n(\widetilde\theta)^{-1}
S_n(\widetilde\theta)
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

실제 restriction dimension에 맞춘 projection/restriction form으로 계산한다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

증명 개요 13.1 · Local quadratic likelihood geometry

:::::::::::::::::::

regular correct specification과 local perturbation $h/\sqrt n$ 아래에서는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_n\left(
\theta_0+\frac h{\sqrt n}
\right)
-
\ell_n(\theta_0)
=
h'
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0)
-
\frac12
h'\mathcal I_0h
+
o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

score term은 random linear component를, Fisher information은 deterministic quadratic curvature를 제공한다. Wald, LR, Score test는 동일한 local geometry의 서로 다른 표현이다.

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.10.5 First-order equivalence and misspecification {#s13105}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.display-table-wrap}

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Test</th><th>Geometric interpretation</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Wald</td><td>unrestricted estimate와 null set의 distance</td></tr>
<tr><td>LR</td><td>restricted와 unrestricted objective values의 gap</td></tr>
<tr><td>Score / LM</td><td>restricted point에서의 local slope</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::::::::::::::::::::

regular correctly specified likelihood에서는 세 test가 first-order asymptotically equivalent하다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

Misspecified likelihood에서의 주의

:::::::::::::::::::

QMLE에서는 standard likelihood-ratio statistic이 automatically standard chi-square limit을 갖는다고 생각하면 안 된다.
Robust covariance를 이용한 Wald-type inference는 pseudo-true target에 대한 regular QMLE inference와 더 직접적으로 연결된다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.5 · Scalar Wald, LR, and Score statistics have the same leading quadratic form

:::::::::::::::::::

scalar regular null $H_0:\theta=\theta_0$에 대해

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
W
=
n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)^2\mathcal I_0
+
o_p(1),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
LR
=
n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)^2\mathcal I_0
+
o_p(1),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
LM
=
\frac{S_n(\theta_0)^2}{n\mathcal I_0}
+
o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Since

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)
=
\mathcal I_0^{-1}
\frac1{\sqrt n}S_n(\theta_0)
+
o_p(1),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

세 통계량은 first-order equivalent하며 모두 $\chi_1^2$로 수렴한다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명 · First-order equivalence in the scalar regular case

:::::::::::::::::::

Wald expression은 asymptotic variance $\mathcal I_0^{-1}/n$에서 바로 나온다. LR expression은 restricted와 unrestricted optimum 주위의 local quadratic log-likelihood expansion에서 나오고, Score expression은 null score를 variance $n\mathcal I_0$로 표준화한 것이다. 마지막으로 MLE score expansion에 의해

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)^2\mathcal I_0
=
\frac{S_n(\theta_0)^2}{n\mathcal I_0}
+
o_p(1).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 세 통계량은 동일한 leading term을 공유한다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.5 · Standard LR need not be chi-square under misspecification

:::::::::::::::::::

다시 working likelihood $Y_i\sim N(\mu,1)$를 사용하되 true data는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[Y_i]=0,
\qquad
\operatorname{Var}(Y_i)=\tau^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 만족한다고 하자. $H_0:\mu=0$을 검정할 때 unrestricted QMLE는 $\widehat\mu=\bar Y$이고 working likelihood-ratio statistic은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
LR
=
n\bar Y^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

But

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\sqrt n\,\bar Y
\Rightarrow
N(0,\tau^2),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

so

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
LR
\Rightarrow
\tau^2\chi_1^2,
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이며 $\tau^2=1$이 아니면 $\chi_1^2$가 아니다. 반면 robust Wald statistic은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
W_R
=
\frac{n\bar Y^2}{\widehat\tau^2}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

consistent variance estimation 아래 standard $\chi_1^2$ limit를 갖는다.

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s1311x}

## [13.11]{.section-number}Computing Maximum Likelihood

::: {.topic-opening}
Likelihood theory의 statistical target과 numerical optimization problem은 연결되어 있지만 동일하지 않다.
이 절에서는 score와 curvature가 실제 algorithms에 어떻게 들어가는지 본다.
:::

### 13.11.1 Newton–Raphson {#s13111}

score와 Hessian을

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
S_n(\theta)=\nabla\ell_n(\theta),
\qquad
H_n(\theta)=\nabla^2\ell_n(\theta)
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라 하면 Newton update는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^{(m+1)}
=
\theta^{(m)}
-
H_n(\theta^{(m)})^{-1}
S_n(\theta^{(m)}).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

locally quadratic likelihood에서는 빠른 convergence를 기대할 수 있지만,
Hessian이 ill-conditioned하거나 starting value가 나쁘면 불안정할 수 있다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.6 · Newton–Raphson from a local quadratic approximation

:::::::::::::::::::

$\theta$ 주위의 second-order approximation은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_n(\theta+d)
\approx
\ell_n(\theta)
+
S_n(\theta)'d
+
\frac12d'H_n(\theta)d.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

quadratic approximation을 최대화하면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
d
=
-H_n(\theta)^{-1}S_n(\theta),
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이고 따라서 Newton update를 얻는다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

quadratic approximation을 $d$에 대해 미분하면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
S_n(\theta)+H_n(\theta)d=0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hessian이 nonsingular이면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
d=-H_n(\theta)^{-1}S_n(\theta).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.11.2 Fisher scoring {#s13112}

observed Hessian 대신 expected information을 사용하는 update:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\theta^{(m+1)}
=
\theta^{(m)}
+
\mathcal I_n(\theta^{(m)})^{-1}
S_n(\theta^{(m)}).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이는 expected curvature를 이용한다는 점에서 Newton–Raphson과 구별된다.

### 13.11.3 Local maxima, scaling, and constraints {#s13113}

<ul>
<li>starting values와 multiple local maxima,</li>
<li>flat하거나 nearly singular한 Hessian,</li>
<li>parameter scaling,</li>
<li>line search와 trust-region safeguards,</li>
<li>positivity, probability, variance에 대한 parameter constraints</li>
</ul>

등이 실제 likelihood computation에서 중요하다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{optimizer convergence}
\neq
\text{global maximum certification}
\neq
\text{statistical identification}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

계산 13.1 · Numerical error must be below the statistical first-order scale

:::::::::::::::::::

exact MLE을 $\widehat\theta_n$라 하고 numerical solution $\widetilde\theta_n$이

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\widetilde\theta_n-\widehat\theta_n
=
o_p(n^{-1/2}),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 만족하면 두 estimator는 동일한 first-order asymptotic distribution을 갖는다. Locally nonsingular Hessian 아래에서는 다음 score-based condition이 sufficient하다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\left\|
\frac1nS_n(\widetilde\theta_n)
\right\|
=
o_p(n^{-1/2}).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 fixed optimizer tolerance가 모든 $n$에서 자동으로 적절한 것은 아니다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .counterexample}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

반례 13.6 · Complete separation in logit can destroy finite MLE existence

:::::::::::::::::::

다음 조건을 만족하는 vector $b$가 존재한다고 하자.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
X_i'b\gt0
\quad\text{whenever }Y_i=1,
\qquad
X_i'b\lt0
\quad\text{whenever }Y_i=0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$t\to\infty$인 ray $\beta=tb$를 따라가면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\Lambda(X_i'\beta)\to1
\quad(Y_i=1),
\qquad
\Lambda(X_i'\beta)\to0
\quad(Y_i=0).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

log likelihood는 supremum에 접근하지만 그 supremum이 finite한 $\beta$에서 달성될 필요는 없다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{concavity}
\not\Rightarrow
\text{existence of a finite MLE}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s1312x}

## [13.12]{.section-number}Examples: Normal Regression, Logit, and Poisson QMLE

::: {.topic-opening}
같은 likelihood architecture가 familiar econometric models에서 어떻게 나타나는지 확인한다.
:::

### 13.12.1 Normal linear regression {#s13121}

conditional model:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
Y_i\mid X_i
\sim
N(X_i'\beta,\sigma^2).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

log likelihood:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell(\beta,\sigma^2)
=
-\frac n2\log(2\pi)
-\frac n2\log\sigma^2
-\frac{1}{2\sigma^2}
\sum_{i=1}^n
(Y_i-X_i'\beta)^2.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

$\beta$에 대해 maximize하는 것은 residual sum of squares를 minimize하는 것과 같으므로

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\beta_{MLE}
=
\widehat\beta_{OLS}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

그러나 variance MLE는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\sigma^2_{MLE}
=
\frac1n
\sum_i
(Y_i-X_i'\widehat\beta)^2,
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

로서 unbiased residual variance $RSS/(n-k)$와 다르다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.7 · Normal regression MLE recovers OLS and $RSS/n$

:::::::::::::::::::

For

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
Y\mid X\sim N(X'\beta,\sigma^2),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

$\beta$에 대한 score는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial\ell}{\partial\beta}
=
\frac1{\sigma^2}
X'(Y-X\beta).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\beta_{MLE}
=
(X'X)^{-1}X'Y.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Also

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial\ell}{\partial\sigma^2}
=
-\frac n{2\sigma^2}
+
\frac{RSS}{2\sigma^4},
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

so

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\widehat\sigma^2_{MLE}
=
RSS/n.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

$\beta$-score를 0으로 두면 OLS normal equations를 얻는다. $\sigma^2$-score를 0으로 두고 $2\sigma^4$를 곱하면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
-n\sigma^2+RSS=0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Hence $\widehat\sigma^2=RSS/n$.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .remark}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

연결 13.2 · Gaussian QMLE reproduces the BLP target

:::::::::::::::::::

conditional normality가 거짓이더라도 constant variance Gaussian working likelihood를 $\beta$에 대해 최대화하는 것은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
P_n(Y-X'\beta)^2.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

를 최소화하는 것과 같다. 따라서 population pseudo-true coefficient는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\beta^\dagger
=
\operatorname*{arg\,min}_b
E[(Y-X'b)^2]
=
\beta^{BLP}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이다. 즉 Chapter 6의 best linear predictor가 Gaussian QMLE의 pseudo-true parameter로 다시 등장한다.

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.12.2 Binary logit {#s13122}

binary response model:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
P(Y_i=1\mid X_i)
=
p_i
=
\Lambda(X_i'\beta),
\qquad
\Lambda(t)=\frac{e^t}{1+e^t}.
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

individual log likelihood:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_i(\beta)
=
Y_i\log p_i
+
(1-Y_i)\log(1-p_i).
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

score:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
s_i(\beta)
=
X_i(Y_i-p_i).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

Hessian:

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\nabla_\beta^2\ell_n(\beta)
=
-
\sum_i
p_i(1-p_i)
X_iX_i'.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

score는 nonlinear model에서도 “regressor × generalized residual”의 orthogonality structure를 갖는다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.8 · Logit score and concavity

:::::::::::::::::::

Let $p_i=\Lambda(X_i'\beta)$. Since

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial p_i}{\partial\beta}
=
p_i(1-p_i)X_i,
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Bernoulli score는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
s_i(\beta)
=
X_i(Y_i-p_i),
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

그리고 Hessian은

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\nabla_\beta^2\ell_n(\beta)
=
-\sum_i
p_i(1-p_i)X_iX_i'.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

따라서 log-likelihood는 concave하다. 그러나 strict concavity와 finite existence에는 추가 조건이 필요하다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

Differentiate

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_i
=
Y_i\log p_i+(1-Y_i)\log(1-p_i).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

logistic derivative를 사용하면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\frac{\partial\ell_i}{\partial\beta}
=
X_i(Y_i-p_i).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

한 번 더 미분하면
$$
-p_i(1-p_i)X_iX_i'
$$
를 얻는다. 이를 $i$에 대해 합하면 Hessian이다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.12.3 Poisson QMLE {#s13123}

conditional mean을

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
E[Y\mid X]
=
\mu(X,\beta)
=
\exp(X'\beta)
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

라고 model한다고 하자. Poisson working log likelihood를 사용하면 score는

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
s_i(\beta)
=
X_i(Y_i-\mu_i).
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

따라서 true conditional distribution이 Poisson이 아니더라도 conditional mean model이 올바르면

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[
X(Y-\mu(X,\beta_0))
]
=
0
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이 성립할 수 있고, appropriate regularity 아래 Poisson QMLE는 mean parameter를 consistently estimate할 수 있다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

주의 13.4 · Mean correctness와 Poisson distribution correctness는 다르다

:::::::::::::::::::

$\operatorname{Var}(Y\mid X)=E[Y\mid X]$라는 Poisson variance restriction이 틀릴 수 있다.
이 경우 conventional inverse-information standard errors보다 robust sandwich covariance가 필요하다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .proposition}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

명제 13.9 · Poisson QMLE score, curvature, and robust covariance

:::::::::::::::::::

With

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\mu_i
=
\exp(X_i'\beta),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Poisson working log likelihood의 score는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
s_i(\beta)
=
X_i(Y_i-\mu_i)
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

and Hessian

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
H_i(\beta)
=
-\mu_iX_iX_i'.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

conditional mean이 correctly specified이면

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[Y\mid X]
=
\mu(X,\beta_0),
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

then $E[s_i(\beta_0)]=0$. Define

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
A
=
E[\mu(X,\beta_0)XX'],
\qquad
B
=
E[XX'(Y-\mu)^2].
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

Poisson-QMLE의 asymptotic covariance는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
V_{PQMLE}
=
A^{-1}BA^{-1}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

이고 $\operatorname{Var}(Y\mid X)=\mu(X,\beta_0)$이면 $B=A$이므로 covariance는 $A^{-1}$로 단순화된다.

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.proof}

::::::::::::::::::: {.proof-label}

증명

:::::::::::::::::::

Ignoring the term $-\log(Y_i!)$,

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\ell_i(\beta)
=
Y_iX_i'\beta
-
\exp(X_i'\beta).
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

한 번과 두 번 미분하여 stated score와 Hessian을 얻는다. Correct mean specification 아래에서는

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
E[s_i(\beta_0)\mid X_i]
=
X_i
\{E[Y_i\mid X_i]-\mu_i\}
=
0.
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

generic QMLE sandwich는 $A^{-1}BA^{-1}$를 준다. Poisson variance가 correct이면
$$
E[(Y-\mu)^2\mid X]=\mu,
$$
이므로 $B=A$이다.

<span class="qed">□</span>

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s1313x}

## [13.13]{.section-number}What Likelihood Does—and Does Not—Buy Us

::: {.topic-opening}
Likelihood는 강력한 unifying framework지만 identification, interpretation, computation의 모든 문제를 자동으로 해결하지 않는다.
:::

### 13.13.1 What likelihood provides {#s13131}

<ul>
<li>하나의 unified sample criterion,</li>
<li>score-based estimating equations,</li>
<li>information geometry,</li>
<li>correct specification 아래의 efficient regular parametric asymptotics,</li>
<li>Wald, LR, Score를 이용한 inference,</li>
<li>nonlinear probability model을 위한 자연스러운 framework.</li>
</ul>

### 13.13.2 Identification and misspecification {#s13132}

likelihood를 쓴다고 parameter가 자동으로 identified되는 것은 아니다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
f_{\theta_1}=f_{\theta_2}
\quad\text{with}\quad
\theta_1\neq\theta_2
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

이면 parameterization은 observationally nonidentified다.

또한 model family가 틀리면 estimator는 structural truth가 아니라

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\theta^\dagger
=
\operatorname*{arg\,min}_\theta
D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

를 학습한다.

### 13.13.3 Causal interpretation and computation {#s13133}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{precise likelihood estimation}
\neq
\text{causal identification}.
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

causal interpretation에는 별도의 structural/identifying assumptions가 필요하다.
또한 nonconcave likelihood에서는 local optimizer가 global MLE인지 별도의 확인이 필요할 수 있다.

### 13.13.4 Nonregularity preview {#s13134}

standard likelihood theory는 다음 상황에서 실패하거나 수정이 필요할 수 있다.

<ul>
<li>boundary parameters,</li>
<li>singular information matrices,</li>
<li>mixture models,</li>
<li>null 아래 unidentified nuisance parameters,</li>
<li>weak identification,</li>
<li>parameter-dependent support,</li>
<li>nonstandard convergence rates.</li>
</ul>

:::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{regular likelihood theory}
\text{ is powerful, but it is a local regularity theory.}
}
$$

::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::: {.statement .warning}

::::::::::::::::::: {.statement-head}

실패 유형 13.1 · Four distinct problems that likelihood does not collapse into one

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.display-table-wrap}

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Problem</th><th>What fails</th><th>Typical consequence</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Nonidentification</td><td>서로 다른 $\theta$가 동일한 observed law를 생성</td><td>point target이 아니라 set target</td></tr>
<tr><td>Misspecification</td><td>$f_0$가 working family 바깥에 존재</td><td>KL pseudo-true target과 sandwich covariance</td></tr>
<tr><td>Numerical failure</td><td>algorithm이 global optimum을 놓치거나 finite maximizer가 존재하지 않음</td><td>계산된 값이 statistical estimator와 다름</td></tr>
<tr><td>Nonregularity</td><td>ordinary local quadratic/root-$n$ theory가 붕괴</td><td>nonstandard rate 또는 limiting law</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{good optimization}
\not\Rightarrow
\text{correct specification}
\not\Rightarrow
\text{identification}
\not\Rightarrow
\text{causal interpretation}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#s1314x}

## [13.14]{.section-number}요약과 연습문제

### 13.14.1 Chapter map {#s13141}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.chapter-summary}

::::::::::::::::::: {.chapter-summary__head}

Chapter 13 in one map

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
f_\theta
\longrightarrow
E_0[\log f_\theta(W)]
\longrightarrow
\theta^\dagger
\longrightarrow
\ell_n(\theta)
\longrightarrow
\widehat\theta
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{score}
+
\text{curvature}
+
\text{CLT}
\Longrightarrow
\text{asymptotic normality}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{Correct specification: }
\theta^\dagger=\theta_0,
\quad
H=J=\mathcal I,
\quad
V=\mathcal I^{-1}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{Misspecification: }
\theta^\dagger=\text{KL projection},
\quad
H\neq J\text{ generally},
\quad
V=H^{-1}JH^{-1}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.14.2 MLE/QMLE comparison {#s13142}

:::::::::::::::::::: {.display-table-wrap}

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Object</th><th>Correctly specified MLE</th><th>QMLE / misspecified likelihood</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Population target</td><td>true $\theta_0$</td><td>KL pseudo-true $\theta^\dagger$</td></tr>
<tr><td>Score mean</td><td>$E_{\theta_0}[s]=0$</td><td>interior pseudo-true target에서 $E_0[s(\theta^\dagger)]=0$</td></tr>
<tr><td>Information equality</td><td>$H=J=\mathcal I$</td><td>not guaranteed</td></tr>
<tr><td>Asymptotic variance</td><td>$\mathcal I^{-1}$</td><td>$H^{-1}JH^{-1}$</td></tr>
<tr><td>Standard LR theory</td><td>regularly available</td><td>standard form이 자동으로 valid한 것은 아님</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::::::::::::::::::::

### 13.14.3 Likelihood checklist {#s13143}

<ol>
<li><strong>Probability model:</strong> 어떤 joint/conditional distribution을 parameterize하는가?</li>
<li><strong>Population target:</strong> expected log likelihood의 maximizer는 무엇인가?</li>
<li><strong>Identification:</strong> 서로 다른 parameter가 서로 다른 observed-data laws를 생성하는가?</li>
<li><strong>Specification:</strong> true law가 model family에 포함된다고 보는가, working likelihood로 보는가?</li>
<li><strong>Consistency:</strong> normalized log likelihood가 uniformly converge하고 target이 separated되어 있는가?</li>
<li><strong>Score:</strong> first-order condition의 estimating function은 무엇인가?</li>
<li>Curvature 측면에서 Hessian/information matrix가 nonsingular한가?</li>
<li><strong>Variance:</strong> information equality를 사용할 수 있는가, sandwich가 필요한가?</li>
<li><strong>Inference:</strong> Wald/LR/Score 중 어떤 test가 현재 specification 아래 정당화되는가?</li>
<li><strong>Computation:</strong> local maximum, scaling, constraints, convergence diagnostics를 확인했는가?</li>
<li><strong>Interpretation:</strong> likelihood parameter와 structural/causal target을 구분했는가?</li>
</ol>

### 연습문제 {#exercises}

<ol class="exercise-list">
<li><strong>Likelihood and log-likelihood.</strong> strictly increasing transformation을 이용해 $\arg\max L_n=\arg\max\ell_n$을 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Likelihood is not posterior.</strong> Bernoulli likelihood를 쓰고 왜 그것이 parameter density가 아닌지 설명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Conditional likelihood.</strong> $f_\theta(y,x)=f_\theta(y\mid x)f_X(x)$에서 $f_X$가 $\theta$-free일 때 joint/conditional argmax equivalence를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Likelihood implies moments.</strong> regular correct likelihood에서 score moment restriction이 어떻게 생성되는지 보이라.</li>
<li><strong>KL decomposition.</strong> expected log likelihood maximization과 KL minimization이 동치임을 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Gibbs inequality.</strong> $\log x\le x-1$을 이용해 $D_{KL}(f_0\Vert f_\theta)\ge0$를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>KL identification.</strong> correct specification과 distributional identification에서 $\theta_0$가 unique population maximizer임을 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Observational equivalence.</strong> $P_{\theta_1}=P_{\theta_2}$인 distinct parameters가 있을 때 population likelihood maximizer set을 characterize하라.</li>
<li><strong>Support failure.</strong> $f_\theta=0$인 region에서 $f_0\gt0$이면 KL divergence가 infinite가 되는 이유를 설명하라.</li>
<li><strong>MLE as M.</strong> negative log likelihood를 이용해 MLE를 M-estimator로 표현하라.</li>
<li><strong>Score as Z.</strong> smooth interior MLE의 score equation을 Z-estimation form으로 쓰라.</li>
<li><strong>FOC is not MLE.</strong> $\ell(\theta)=-(\theta^2-1)^2$에서 score roots와 maxima를 비교하라.</li>
<li><strong>MLE consistency.</strong> uniform convergence, separation gap, near-maximizer condition으로 likelihood argmax consistency를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Model truth versus consistency.</strong> $\hat\theta\to_p\theta^\dagger$가 $f_0=f_{\theta^\dagger}$를 imply하지 않는 이유를 설명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Score identity.</strong> $E_\theta[s(W,\theta)]=0$를 differentiation under the integral sign으로 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Information equality.</strong> score identity를 다시 미분하여 $-E[H]=E[ss']$를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Uniform-support counterexample.</strong> $Y\sim U(0,\theta)$에서 formal score mean이 zero가 아닌 이유를 support dependence로 설명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Three information matrices.</strong> observed Hessian, OPG, expected information을 정의하고 correct specification에서 population limits를 비교하라.</li>
<li><strong>Integrated Hessian.</strong> fundamental theorem of calculus로 exact multivariate score expansion을 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>MLE asymptotic normality.</strong> score CLT와 local Hessian LLN으로 inverse-information limit를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>MLE influence function.</strong> $IF(W)=\mathcal I^{-1}s(W,\theta_0)$를 유도하고 covariance를 계산하라.</li>
<li><strong>Parametric efficiency.</strong> $\phi=\mathcal I^{-1}s+r$ decomposition으로 covariance lower bound를 증명하라.</li>
<li><strong>Gaussian pseudo-truth.</strong> arbitrary finite-variance $Y$에 Gaussian working likelihood를 적용해 $\mu^\dagger=E[Y]$, $\sigma^{2\dagger}=\operatorname{Var}(Y)$를 유도하라.</li><li><strong>Boundary pseudo-score.</strong> $\Theta=[0,\infty)$, $M(\theta)=-(\theta+1)^2$에서 maximizer가 score zero를 만족하지 않음을 보이라.</li><li><strong>QMLE ALR.</strong> integrated-Hessian score expansion에서 QMLE asymptotic linear representation을 유도하라.</li><li><strong>QMLE sandwich.</strong> score CLT로 $H^{-1}JH^{-1}$를 도출하라.</li><li><strong>Sandwich consistency.</strong> local ULLN과 random-index plug-in logic으로 $\hat H\to_pH,\hat J\to_pJ,\hat V\to_pV$를 증명하라.</li><li><strong>Misspecified normal mean.</strong> working $N(\mu,1)$, true variance $\tau^2$에서 $H=1,J=\tau^2$를 계산하라.</li><li><strong>Wald/LR/Score.</strong> scalar regular null에서 세 statistics가 같은 leading quadratic form을 갖는 것을 보이라.</li><li><strong>Misspecified LR.</strong> working $N(\mu,1)$에서 $LR=n\bar Y^2\Rightarrow\tau^2\chi_1^2$를 유도하라.</li><li><strong>Newton–Raphson.</strong> local quadratic approximation에서 Newton update를 유도하라.</li><li><strong>Fisher scoring.</strong> Newton–Raphson과 Fisher scoring의 curvature matrix를 비교하라.</li><li><strong>Numerical tolerance.</strong> $\tilde\theta-\hat\theta=o_p(n^{-1/2})$가 first-order equivalence에 충분한 이유를 설명하고 normalized score residual condition과 연결하라.</li><li><strong>Normal regression.</strong> Gaussian conditional likelihood에서 $\hat\beta_{MLE}=\hat\beta_{OLS}$, $\hat\sigma^2=RSS/n$을 유도하라.</li><li><strong>Gaussian QMLE and BLP.</strong> conditional normality가 틀려도 Gaussian quasi-likelihood의 $\beta^\dagger$가 BLP임을 증명하라.</li><li><strong>Logit.</strong> Bernoulli log-likelihood에서 score와 Hessian을 유도하고 concavity를 보이라.</li><li><strong>Complete separation.</strong> logit separation에서 finite MLE가 존재하지 않을 수 있음을 parameter ray argument로 설명하라.</li><li><strong>Poisson QMLE.</strong> score, Hessian, $A,B$, robust sandwich를 유도하고 Poisson variance restriction이 맞을 때 $A^{-1}$로 단순화됨을 보이라.</li></ol>

::::::::::::::::::::::::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#references .references}

## 참고문헌 및 다음 장

이 장은 likelihood를 Chapter 11의 M/Z-estimation과 연결하면서,
population expected log likelihood, KL projection, score, Hessian, information matrix,
MLE/QMLE asymptotics, robust sandwich covariance, Wald/LR/Score inference를 하나의 구조로 정리한다.
Correct specification에서는 Fisher information identity가 generic sandwich를 inverse-information form으로 단순화하고,
misspecification에서는 pseudo-true KL target과 robust sandwich covariance가 다시 핵심이 된다.

:::::::::::::::::::: {.chapter-summary}

::::::::::::::::::: {.chapter-summary__head}

다음 장으로

:::::::::::::::::::

Chapter 11–13은 regular estimation theory의 기본 toolbox를 완성한다.
다음 장에서는 이 regular theory가 실패하거나 불안정해지는 상황—
weak identification, singular information, boundary parameters, unidentified nuisance parameters, nonstandard rates—
을 하나의 nonregular estimation framework로 묶어 분석할 수 있다.

::::::::::::::::::: {.math-display}

$$
\boxed{
\text{regular M/Z, GMM, likelihood theory}
\longrightarrow
\text{nonregularity and weak identification}.
}
$$

:::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::
